free_tier.stated: USD 200 of Azure credit for 30 days on a new account; the monthly 750-hour allowance names B1s, B2pts v2 and B2ats v2, all burstable CPU sizes, so a GPU VM is paid from the credit. At the East US on-demand rate that is 54.45 A100 80 GB card-hours (USD 200 / USD 3.673) or 18.08 H100 80 GB card-hours (USD 200 / USD 11.061). No GPU size carries a free hour.

limits.value: Azure GPU sizes bill per hour of wall clock at the published retail rate and carry no free hour; the free account's monthly 750 hours name B1s, B2pts v2 and B2ats v2, so a GPU VM runs on the USD 200 credit

identity_cost.detail: A phone number, a credit card or a debit card (non-prepaid) and a Microsoft account or a GitHub account are all required, and the vendor states the phone and the card are used for identity verification. The free account is available in the 140 countries and regions the vendor lists and the offer is not available in a country that is not on it; only credit cards are accepted in Hong Kong and Brazil.
